name: Consultant, DevOps Engineer
description:
Consultant at Avanade, continuing the Azure platform and DevOps engagement started as a Senior Analyst in late 2023.

- Contributed to a configuration-driven Terraform and GitHub Actions platform supporting approximately 20 Azure environments.
- Built and maintained reusable infrastructure modules and deployment workflows, including automation for Azure Red Hat OpenShift (ARO).
- Worked on secure deployments with private networking, self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, managed identities, Azure RBAC, and infrastructure security checks.
- Applied software engineering practices to infrastructure work through versioning, pull requests, reusable components, and documentation.
- Helped improve GitHub Copilot workflows with repository instructions and specialized agents.

name: Senior Analyst, Full-Stack Developer
description:
Worked across banking, energy, and Azure platform engineering engagements, moving from application development into infrastructure automation while keeping software engineering at the core.

- Delivered tested .NET regulatory changes for a Belgian energy-sector application.
- Improved SQL Server processing and built Python checks to identify missing messages and data inconsistencies.
- Mentored three engineering interns in 2025 through Scrum delivery and code reviews on a .NET/React/Azure internal project; two subsequently joined Avanade.
- Contributed to Terraform and GitHub Actions automation for an Azure platform engagement starting in late 2023, before the December 2025 promotion to Consultant.
- Collaborated with developers and architects on application delivery, code quality, and maintainable infrastructure.

name: Analyst Developer
description:
A Belgian non-profit IT organization that partners with public sector institutions to design and deliver secure, innovative, and scalable digital services for citizens and government agencies. Worked at the Belgian National Employment Office (ONEM) through Smals.

- Contributed to mainframe system migration to Linux and modernization of legacy systems.  
- Maintained and debugged a C++ shared library on Linux and supported a custom mainframe emulator.  
- Developed web applications using Angular, Spring Boot, Docker, and Kubernetes to support government workflows.  
- Automated deployments using Atlassian Bamboo, improving release speed and reliability.  
- Worked within agile teams, using Jira for sprint planning and Bitbucket for source control.  
- Implemented testing strategies with Cypress, Cucumber, Jest, and JUnit to ensure code quality and coverage.

name: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Part of the Microsoft Innovation Center's Prototyping Internship Programme (training, technical mentors and a student cohort at the MIC, with the project at Avanade).

- Designed and developed Azure DevOps extensions to support Scrum teams through daily sentiment tracking and reporting.
- Developed a React and TypeScript frontend for collecting team feedback through a Niko-Niko calendar.
- Built REST APIs using C#/.NET and Azure Functions, integrating Azure Table Storage and Azure Key Vault.
- Implemented reporting and data visualization features to help Scrum Masters identify team sentiment trends.
